title: LEGO Made 10 Billion Minifigures—More Than Humanity
hook: LEGO made 10 billion minifigures, more than the human population.
closing: A toy population now outnumbers humanity, and it keeps growing faster.
question: How many minifigures live with you?

segments.say: LEGO made 10 billion minifigures. The plastic population now exceeds the number of people alive.
LEGO minifigures reached 8.3 billion by 2019. The toy population outgrew humanity within four decades.
LEGO makes 400 million minifigures yearly. New figures arrive almost three times faster than babies.
